facts: Run `ib_read write` for all ConnectX-7 and BlueField-3 ports for one hour.
Bandwidth must match SPEC; machine time is 500 minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL but gives invalid/ambiguous `ib_read_bw -d <port> -t 3600` and no peer/server orchestration.

original_test_intent.statement: Stress every required CX-7 and BF3 data port for one hour using the owner-approved read/write transport benchmark and compare per-port bandwidth and errors to SPEC.
must_preserve: All listed adapter ports, read and write intent, one hour and SPEC comparison.
unknowns: Ethernet/RoCE versus InfiniBand mode, local/peer topology, RDMA device/port mapping, benchmark roles/options and numeric thresholds.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: The missing map/recipe is provisionable; once supplied, the paired traffic and evidence are technically automatable.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: No traffic is ready, but this is not inherently BLOCKED. Owner must reconcile Ethernet/RoCE/IB mode and provide both endpoint commands, port map and thresholds.

revision_candidate.test_name: Stress All CX-7 and BF3 Data Ports for One Hour
revision_candidate.purpose: Run the approved bidirectional/read-and-write RDMA or Ethernet workload on every mapped port and verify per-port bandwidth and error counters against the platform SPEC.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Pinned CX-7/BF3 firmware/driver/OFED stack and owner-declared Ethernet/RoCE or InfiniBand fabric with peers.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every physical adapter port mapped to PCI BDF, netdev/RDMA device and peer; management interfaces excluded unless explicitly listed.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Port/peer/topology and transport-mode map, server/client commands, message size/depth/concurrency/direction, one-hour allocation, numeric SPEC/tolerance, counter baseline and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Read-only map and counters first. After recipe approval, start peers in correct roles and exercise each port for the declared one-hour coverage, preserving full output and counter deltas.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Links meet expected speed/width/state/MTU, routing/VLAN/RDMA config and isolated management path.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: BDF/port/netdev/RDMA/peer map; link mode/rate/FEC/MTU; tool/firmware/driver versions; exact endpoint commands/times; per-port throughput and retry/drop/CRC/FEC/RDMA counters; kernel/BMC/SEL deltas.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Each port meets its signed bandwidth/tolerance and error-counter policy; aggregate throughput cannot mask a failed port.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not guess `${ETH_PORTS}`, use `-d` as a port without tool-version proof, omit peer command, mix IB with Ethernet/RoCE or disrupt management.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Network owner supplies recipe/topology and approves load window.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Cabling/fabric setup may be manual; traffic/evidence can be automated.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop both endpoints, restore network config, preserve counters and verify all links/management.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Mode/topology ambiguity, link loss, counter spike, host impact, wrong interface, package mismatch or incomplete per-port evidence.

identified_defects: DeepSeek command does not establish read+write/all-port traffic.
reason_for_change: A complete port/peer recipe can be executed automatically; blocking capability because the handoff omitted it hides the actual network-engineering decisions still required.
removed_ambiguities: Physical/RDMA/netdev identity and both endpoint roles are explicit.
remaining_blockers: Transport, topology and numeric SPEC remain missing.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 retains the no-traffic gate but distinguishes a resolvable handoff from permanent inability and prevents an invalid single-ended command from masquerading as all-port Ethernet stress.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Validator independently preserved every CX-7/BF3 port, transport-mode and execution-location separation, both endpoint roles, full one-hour per-port coverage, option proof, management isolation and per-port acceptance.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Row 75 names all CX7/BF3, read/write, one hour and SPEC bandwidth while leaving ports and peers absent.
